name: gemini-audio-mcp
description: High-quality environmental soundscape generator using Gemini 2.0 Multimodal Live API.
author: Gemini Audio MCP Contributors

tools.name: generate_soundscape
tools.description: Generates a high-quality environmental soundscape using Gemini 2.0 Multimodal Live API.

tools.name: transition_soundscape
tools.description: Generates two soundscapes and crossfades between them.

tools.name: configure
tools.description: View or update persistent configuration and defaults.

tools.name: play_audio
tools.description: Plays an audio file using the system's default player.

tools.name: cleanup_assets
tools.description: Deletes generated audio files older than a specified age.
